meta.title: Kalm — The phone for what matters. Not for endless scrolling.
meta.description: Kalm is a compact phone with a real keypad and a small touchscreen, made for calls, messages, maps and work — not for endless feeds. Spend less time on your screen.

hero.subtitle: A compact phone with real keys and a small touchscreen — for calls, messages, maps and work. Everything you need, without the habit of scrolling for hours.

why.title: Your smartphone is built to keep you scrolling. Kalm is built to let you go.
why.intro: Feeds, notifications and autoplay are designed to hold your attention for as long as possible. Kalm keeps what you actually need and makes the rest far less tempting — so the minutes you used to lose come back to you.

points.title: Only the essentials
points.text: Calls, messages, navigation and the tools you need for work. Stay reachable — without a device designed to keep you hooked.

points.title: Made for tasks, not for scrolling
points.text: A compact screen and a real keypad make it quick to do what you picked up the phone for — and easy to put it back in your pocket.

points.title: Time back for real life
points.text: Spend the hours you win back on people, sleep, sport and your own projects — not on a feed that never ends.

items.q: How does Kalm help me spend less time on my phone?
items.a: It is designed for purposeful use. The compact screen and physical keypad make calls, messages and quick tasks easy, while long scrolling sessions become much less comfortable. You can use it as your everyday phone and keep a larger device at home for the occasional task that really needs it. How much time you save depends on your habits.

items.q: Is this a smartphone or a traditional button phone?
items.a: Both. Kalm has a colour touchscreen in the upper half and a full physical keypad in the lower half. You can navigate with touch, with the keys, or with both.
Yes. Kalm runs Android 11, so you can install Android apps — messengers, maps, music and more. The 2.8" touchscreen and the keypad make quick tasks easy without inviting endless scrolling.
Yes. WhatsApp is an Android app and can be installed on Kalm (Android 11).
Yes. Telegram can be installed on Kalm (Android 11).
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and a mobile hotspot. If you need to check compatibility with your mobile operator, send us a message and we'll help.

sections.h: Orders and conclusion of the contract
sections.p:
The buyer fills in the order form on the website. Within 1 business day of receiving the order, the Seller contacts the buyer by email or phone to confirm the quantity, price, delivery address and payment method.
The sales contract is concluded when the Seller confirms the order and the buyer pays for the product in the agreed way.

Prices are shown in euros and are final. Delivery is free of charge.
No payments are taken on the website and no card details are requested — the payment method is agreed with the buyer when the order is confirmed.

Products are delivered free of charge: within 3 days in Lithuania and within 7–10 days to other European countries, counted from order confirmation and payment. See "Shipping and Returns" for details.
Ownership and the risk of accidental loss pass to the buyer when the product is handed over to them.

A consumer may withdraw from the contract within 14 days of receiving the product without giving a reason, by notifying the Seller in writing (by email) and stating the order number.
The product must be returned within 14 days of sending the notice. The money, including the original delivery cost, is refunded within 14 days of receiving the notice using the same payment method; the Seller may withhold the refund until the product has been received.
The buyer bears the direct cost of returning the product, unless it is defective or not what was ordered. The buyer is liable for any loss of value resulting from handling beyond what is necessary to establish the nature, characteristics and functioning of the product.

A 2-year legal guarantee applies to any lack of conformity of the product. If a defect is found, the buyer may require free repair or replacement, a price reduction or termination of the contract as provided by law.
The guarantee does not cover damage caused by improper use, mechanical damage, moisture or unauthorised repair.

The buyer is responsible for the accuracy of the details provided in the order form. The Seller is not liable for delivery delays caused by inaccurate details provided by the buyer or by circumstances beyond the Seller's control.
The buyer's personal data is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Lithuania; this does not deprive a consumer of the protection afforded by the mandatory laws of their country of habitual residence.
Disputes are resolved by negotiation. Consumers may also contact the State Consumer Rights Protection Authority of Lithuania (Vilniaus g. 25, Vilnius, www.vvtat.lt), their national consumer authority, or the courts.
The Seller may amend these terms. An order is governed by the terms in force when it was placed.

Free delivery to all European countries.
Lithuania: within 3 days. Other European countries: 7–10 days.
Delivery times are counted from order confirmation and payment. We send tracking details once your order has shipped.

You can return the product within 14 days of receiving it without giving a reason. Email us with your order number and we will send you return instructions.
The product must be undamaged and complete. We refund the money within 14 days of receiving your notice (we may wait until we receive the product). Return shipping is paid by the buyer.
The product comes with a 2-year guarantee. If it is faulty or not as described, contact us — we will repair or replace it free of charge or refund you, and we cover the return shipping.
